introduction: Follow Dawndale's refugee preparations, rival ship-captain recipes, hunter and worm deliveries, and Whetstone's foreign forge return. Active, ready accounting is mandatory. Producer histories explain the route without rejecting supplied proof. Three support services and the fossil referral give no achievement or daily credit; source, payment and actual escape/curse effects need qualification.
orientation: The surface has three routes into the valley. Quest descriptions give clues, while addressed questions exist for Drandagger, the smith and Whetstone. Meeting a giver reveals relevant requests; discovering the zone alone does not complete a delivery or award a learned-keyword milestone.

The curator's portrait gives refugee stones; the rock cutter converts them to dust and 250 platinum; the phantom engineer makes an explosive device and retires. A separate key-and-device delivery retires the refugee leader and gives an exquisite moonstone and Longhollow backpack. Supplied exact materials fit without your personal earlier deliveries.

The exiled moon-elf sells the city key for 250 platinum, but that coin-only support purchase remains guarded. Unlocking the city gate retains its zero-break-chance key, which can then be offered in the final refugee delivery. The capital, museum, office and elf-alcove keys are different items; breakable office/alcove keys also require return and reset planning.

At the joined wrecks, each rival captain needs two sunlight vials, dust, rank-water bucket, glowing runestones, witchcraft guide and monkey fur. Choose which bundle to spend; each captain gives his own reward and consumes independent proof. The book describes an incantation, but neither reading it nor reciting words replaces its delivery.

The chemist has three declared sunlight vials, while both captains together need four. The scholar appears only on a fifty-percent declaration and shares a globally capped guide with an administrative library. Accepted supply and renewal need qualification; the journal does not promise that every ingredient is currently obtainable.

Keenfeather accepts the master hunter's exact splintered bow. The orc accepts the warchief's treasure after you open its closed, unlocked sack and recover the contents loose. Other bows, the sack, nearby coin piles and similar rewards do not fit those deliveries.

Ask Drandagger hi, hello, help or assistance. Recover the larvae nest from the rock worm's nest for experience and chainmail. His promised tunneling and the refugees' narrated BOOM do not currently open a new escape route or record a settled party.

Ask the smith lens or telescope, then pile, fine or sand. His clue points to the hidden Aravne sand elemental, whose death produces the exact sand. Sand plus 25 platinum supports a lens commission, but mixed payment remains guarded; possession does not establish your own recovery or a repaired telescope.

Ask Whetstone metal. Recover his hidden electrum near Fossil Rock, take it to Emition in the Home of the Divine, then return the exact forged flute. Whetstone retires and leaves a different same-named flute. The foreign forge history is optional, and his promised visit to Emition is not actual recorded travel.

Push rocks on your side of the narrow rock passage to clear that direction's blockage, then search to reveal the passage and walk through. It is an open secret passage rather than a locked door. The other direction has its own rocks, so qualify return separately. Other secret closed wreck passages need search and opening.

The elf-alcove portal leads to a secluded surface island. Arrival, safe return and access are separate from quest delivery. Cliff and avalanche descriptions contain no reviewed falling-room declaration here; route prose alone does not create a fall objective.

The rock cutter replaces an offered fossil with the same item kind and refers you to an unnamed Ultarium cousin. This is excluded from quest credit and does not multiply supply. Red Star, Mctarvian, captive and great-lens lore have no reviewed additional defense, rescue, bounty or installation outcome.
